answer: Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The thread decay curve is applied at each close, ripple records the drop, and terrace recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. The attacker spends 104 dollars and 4 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
